message.content:
The function copies `tag_len` bytes from a 16-byte `full_tag` into `tag` without validating that `tag_len` is within bounds (0–16). If the caller passes `tag_len > 16`, this reads out of bounds from `full_tag` and writes out of bounds to `tag`.

Answer: 10
